title: Jehoiachin's Rations Tablets — Wikipedia

verification_log.method: Tablets excavated by Koldewey at Babylon (1899–1917) near the Ishtar Gate; in the Vorderasiatisches Museum, Berlin (VAT 16378 pictured); record oil rations for Ya'u-kīnu king of Judah and five sons, plus foreign craftsmen; c. 595–570 BC

access_notes: The tablets' editio princeps (Weidner 1939) was not accessed.
